schedule.blurb: A critical care nurse spent ninety minutes floating in warm salt water, said it felt like a week of vacation, and started taking her own care seriously. The Boulder Creek studio came out of that decision.

The redwoods stand close enough that a sliced ball disappears into the shade and you stop looking. Six of the nine holes the CZU fire took are being rebuilt, and there is bluegrass on the Great Lawn on the 19th.
Roshni sketched a banana slug on paper, and Tyler turned it into a digital design. Their First Friday table grew into a Central Avenue shop with locally themed clothing, houseplants and home goods.
Scott Graham and Cristy Aloysi are the artists behind Viscosity's glass. In one-hour classes, visitors work one-on-one with a glassblower to make a piece of their own.
Someone will put a glass of champagne in your hand before you have looked at a rack. It started at the grand opening on the Fourth of July and the owner decided it should never stop.
When Beck's Shoes opened in Boulder Creek on February 3, 2023, the company was already more than a century old. Ole P. Beck founded the business in Salinas in 1919.
Emelia's shop carries statuary, crystals and more than 200 tarot and oracle decks, plus soaps, candles and incense made on site, in the first building on Highway 9 she has owned.
Kelly Ralston and Ashleigh Noce share the paths that brought them to Redwood Mountain Spa and the work they have built together in Boulder Creek.
Robin Imholte is winding down mail-order kits and returning to the hands-on play she loves: slime, tie-dye and sensory parties, library events and community programs.
